notes.title: Quick balance patch
notes.notes:
Made eagles a little easier to kill in melee when unaware.
Made enemies less likely to forget to shout when they see you.

notes.title: 480 FPS Support
notes.notes: Added support for 120 FPS, 240 FPS, and 480 FPS monitors in the settings, making this the fastest Game Maker game on earth probably :P

notes.title: Boot Camp, Autobite
notes.notes:
[b]Boot Camp[/b]: A short tutorial that explains some of the more unique mechanics. If you already know what you're doing you should breeze through it in almost no time.
[b]Autobite[/b]: Hold space to bite the wizards you run by, so you don't have to aim quite so carefully with the keyboard any more.
